{{Top|leg}}
'''Garrow's Neck''' was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was just inland from [[Point Defiance]], one of the westernmost points of the landmass that overlooked the [[Western Sea (Kesh)|Western Sea]], in the direction of the continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]]. The [[Alanciari]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives of Alanciar, maintained a garrison of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] at Garrow's Neck to respond in the event of an [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who lived on Keshtah.
